[EN] The biggest bother of this whole fight is the fact that there's no decent inn nearby.

I don't mind the fighting, and I don't fear the dying, but I dread the sobriety.
[ES] El mayor inconveniente de toda esta pelea es el hecho de que no hay ninguna posada decente cerca.

No me importa luchar, y no temo morir, pero le temo a la sobriedad.
